name: FrenchConnection
detailed_description:
Identical looks, identical height, identical figure—but completely different personalities: twin sisters....

Which one should I choose—the girl I’ve always wanted, or the one who wants me?

A sweet yet bittersweet love story that unfolds between my first love from high school and her twin younger sister, whom I meet as a part-time coworker..

French Connection is a visual novel that plays out like a sweet yet bittersweet cocktail—a drama unfolding between your first love and her younger sister. Take your time to experience and savor the moments that happen with the two of them, and when the final choice comes, we hope it’s one you won’t regret.

Arin Seo (CV. YU HYE - JI)

Age : 21

" I like you… just as much as you like me. "

[ She appears cold and emotionless, but deep down, she’s sensitive and emotionally fragile, burdened by a deep sense of inferiority toward her older sister. Despite her aloof exterior, she is actually quite emotional. Drawn to the protagonist by a sense of similarity, she begins to feel a quiet pull toward him. What kind of relationship will unfold between them? ]

Ara Seo (CV. SIN NA - RI )

Age : 21

" You know… I was just thinking, if I were ever to date someone, maybe being with you wouldn’t have been such a bad idea. "

[ She was always a cheerful and optimistic girl. Back in your school days, you confessed your feelings to her—but before she could answer, you ran off. Now, by chance, you've met her again, and this time, she seems to be interested in you. How will your relationship with her develop? ]

Yuhwa Shin (CV. SON JEONG - MIN )

Age : 27

" If you mess up again, I won’t let it slide this time. So, you better handle it well, alright? I’m counting on you, junior? "

[ This older sister is the owner of the cocktail bar where you work. She seems laid-back and even gives off an almost superhuman sense of calm. While you’re struggling with the sisters, she playfully teases you but offers a few sharp words of advice. What kind of relationship will develop between you and the sisters? ]

[ ABOUT GAME ]

  • This is a simple and easy-to-play visual novel game. Enjoy a bittersweet and cocktail-like deep story, brought to life with high-quality Korean voice acting by professional voice actors from Korea’s official voice acting associations. 

  • Featuring 12 high-quality event CGs and full voice acting for all the main characters.

  • A narrative that prioritizes emotional depth over complex branching paths.

  • Genre - Romance, Drama, Visual Novel

  • Play Time - 3~4 hour, if you heard all voice - 6~7 hour 

[ MINI GAME ] 

  • Sometimes, as you mix and serve drinks, you’ll hear the women’s light-hearted stories, half-truths, or secrets they've kept hidden. Take your time browsing through the recipes think about what you might like, and consider what your guests might enjoy as well. Then, slowly offer them a drink.

  • A simple mini-game is included for you to enjoys. Depending on the drink you serve, the characters’ reactions maybe change from time to time...?

[ Language Setting ]

  • To change the language settings, launch the game and select your preferred language from the bottom right corner of the title screen.

  • *Please note: If you load an existing save file after changing the language, the in-game text may not display correctly. Therefore, we recommend starting a new game from the title screen after changing the language.

[ Game Content Creation and Streaming Guide ]

  • If your created content includes ending scenes, please include a spoiler warning.

  • Monetization is possible for both individuals and corporations, provided that you post a link to the game's store page in the overview or description of your created content.

  • All gameplay videos must include the creator’s audible voice (such as commentary, reactions, or spoken narration). Silent videos (i.e., footage without any spoken audio) are strictly prohibited.

[ STAFF ]

PRODUCER : BANGHAK
DIRECTOR : ARUXi , Chea Shi Ah
Scenario : Beak suk Ju

Developer : zzangminP ,  Chea Shi Ah , conoson

Ui Designer : conoson, ARUXi

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is a romance visual novel that includes consensual sexual scenes as part of its story. These scenes may contain partial nudity and suggestive dialogue and imagery implying sexual activity, but there are no direct or explicit depictions of genitalia.

The game does not contain sensitive topics such as sexual assault, non-consensual sex, drug/alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
